data.title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead

content.basic: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

data.title: We Need to Embed Ethics Into Our Engineering Courses

content.basic: In mid-September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei joined a growing group of researchers calling for the AI industry to slow down. While some have questioned these researchers’ motivation for voicing concerns about the rapid pace of development, the plea highlighted a key tension between safety and speed. The underlying problem is not simply a technical error, but a sociotechnical failure: Pressure to move quickly has made it hard for engineers to fully assess and manage new risks of increasingly powerful AI systems.
